messages:
Maya Patel: Quick heads-up — the post-incident writeup for last night's GPU OOM cascade is published: https://redwood.atlassian.com/RCA-2169. TL;DR: KV-cache leak + aggressive fallback routing caused cascading evictions and autoscaler thrash, resulting in a latency spike for a subset of customers. The doc includes timeline, logs, and telemetry links. Please read the action items section.

Diego Ramos: Confirmed link works. Skimming now. From my read the top-priority actions are: (1) patch KV-cache TTL leak (owner: Alex) — hotfix + prod rollout; (2) increase autoscaler cool-down + add hysteresis (owner: Sasha) — config change + canary; (3) create synthetic spike test for eviction regression (owner: Diego) — integration into ci/scale-suite. Propose 14-day checkpoint to validate metrics.

Alex Chen: I can take the KV-cache TTL fix. I have a draft PR up: https://github.com/redwood/serving/pull/4321. Need reviews from eng-runtime and eng-ml to validate no perf regressions. Targeting hotfix release Wed 03/31 EOD PST.

Sasha Ivanov: I’ll own the autoscaler change. Plan is: update cool-down to 90s, add eviction-rate threshold for scale-down, and roll out a canary to 10% of traffic next Tue 10:00 PST. I’ll coordinate with eng-infra for node pool reservations.

Oncall Bot: Incident timeline and aggregated metrics pushed to #incidents and to the RCA attachments. Key metrics snapshot: 95th latency peaked at 480ms (baseline ~120ms), eviction rate spiked to ~1.4k/min for 22 minutes. Affected customers: 12 orgs (no customer data loss).

Maya Patel: Thanks — I'm adding explicit owners & due dates to the action checklist in the doc. Please add short status updates there as you make progress. We’ll run a 14-day checkpoint sync on Fri 04/11 11:00 AM PST (calendar invite just sent). If you can’t attend, drop notes in the doc or ping me directly. React here with :thumbsup: when you ack your assigned item.

Alex Chen: Ack :thumbsup: — will post PR link and rollout timeline in the doc once reviews are in.

Diego Ramos: Adding the synthetic test to the ci/scale-suite tracker. Also proposing an alert: eviction-rate sustained > 800/min for 5m => paging group-eng-sre. If that sounds reasonable I’ll implement it.

Sasha Ivanov: Sounds good to me. Also adding a small dashboard tile for quick monitoring of eviction trends and Kubernetes pod churn during the canary.

Maya Patel: Great. Appreciate the quick turn. Action owners: please update the checklist by EOD tomorrow so we have clear rollout windows. I’ll follow up after the 14-day checkpoint with a short summary and any remaining owners.

Diego Ramos: Noted — will update tracker by EOD.

Oncall Bot: Reminder scheduled: 14-day checkpoint meeting in 10 days.

Maya Patel: If anyone finds additional related issues in their teams, add them to the "Related Findings" section of the RCA so we can triage them during the checkpoint. Thanks everyone.
